Diagrams written as views exposing what they show
DocGen documents, sections, tables and expression columns lowered to executable views
Cameo simulation configurations written as runnable action defs; result snapshots and Monte Carlo summaries
Pasted images in comments and documents written as image paragraphs from the archive
View Editor cross-references in prose resolved to v2 references
Deferred events (State::deferrableTrigger) kept and replayed through DeferredEvent / DeferredKeeper metadata; the OMG model has no mapping for deferrable triggers
Extend and ExtensionPoint: written as a dependency on the extended use case (v2 has no extend); the OMG model has no mapping for them
fUML / Alf library behaviors called by href computed through the v2 library
